published_source: Printed Table 5, column (5) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2022.4326.pdf), read Nov 4 2026; equals the authors' code output to the printed decimals. The article numbers its tables differently from the code: the code's Table 4 is the printed Table 5 (Directorships of Regulators and Enforcement Actions); the printed Table 4 is summary statistics. The spec's table field keeps the code numbering. Earlier: Not from the article (no article text in the project). Authors' 'code final.do' Tables 4-6 block re-run in Stata MP 16.1 (reghdfe 5.7.3) on the shipped samplems.dta (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2022.4326/stata/t4_t6.do, log t4_t6.log); fixest reproduces it to 7 digits. Column numbers inferred from code order (no-controls column first).
table_note: published article numbering (Nov 4 2026); the authors' code and log number this table 4, which earlier records used
replication_status: exact (authors' code output -0.0762725 (0.0428216), N 6955, equals printed Table 5, column (5) -0.076 (0.043), N 6,955, to the printed decimals; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: Table 4 column (5): reghdfe errorfyear treatheadten if insn==1, absorb(i.fyear##i.sic2 i.gvkey) cluster(gvkey) ('code final.do' Tables 4-6 block, lines 469-491). Outcome: FREP enforcement action for the misstated fiscal year (0/1). Treatment: FREP Head of Enforcement on the firm's board during FREP tenure; hand-coded by gvkey and fiscal year in 'code final.do' lines 137-387. Sample insn = e(sample) of the authors' with-controls regression (fyear > 2003, non-missing treatment and lagged controls, singletons dropped): German listed non-financial firms 2004-2019, 697 firms. FE: firm + two-digit-SIC-by-year (xt_vars = sic2 gives id + t + t^sic2, which spans reghdfe's fyear + sic2 + fyear#sic2). sic2 comes from historical SIC (sich) and varies over time for 71 of 697 firms, so the industry-by-year FE are not strictly a time-invariant characteristic x time; TWFE/BJS use the row-level sic2 exactly as the authors do. 8 treated firms (37 treated firm-years), 689 never-treated firms (99.2% of rows). First-treated years: 2004:1(always-treated), 2007:3(1), 2011:2, 2012:1, 2018:1(always-treated). Only 5 treated firms (cohorts 2007, 2011, 2012) have pre- and post-treatment rows. No switch-offs: post-tenure years are set to missing in the authors' code and are outside the regression sample, so the protocol sample equals the authors' sample. The adjacent with-controls column (laglogat lagroa leverage lagmtb ma big4, winsorized) is not eligible.
